caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest of drawers with a total of five drawers: two smaller drawers at the top and three larger drawers beneath them, arranged vertically. The chest is shown in a three-quarter view, and its surface displays a brown wood grain texture with darker brown lines indicating paneling and shadows. Each drawer is fitted with two oval-shaped, yellow metal handles; the handles have horizontal lines across them, creating a somewhat decorative pattern. Below the chest, there are larger detailed illustrations of one of the handles, shown both in a side view and a front view. The background is a plain, beige or lightly tan color with no additional objects or scenery.
title: Chest
